scope: Isolated shape-only development. Preserve frozen v2 and its benchmark. No Surface ranker, appearance loss, RGB repair or combined method.

training.initialization: Completed v2 epoch 47; all parameters fine-tuned
training.precision: float16 with GradScaler; native validation FP32
training.selection: Maximum validation image-mean native hidden IoU; full IoU breaks ties. No holdout or benchmark checkpoint selection.
training.input_mix: 75% SAM support, 25% annotated support. Empty training SAM uses annotated branch, counted explicitly.
training.augmentation: 50% horizontal flip, 25% extra half-plane occlusion, visible-derived crop padding 1.5-3.0
training.loss: BCE + full Dice + hidden Dice + 0.5 hidden positive BCE. True annotated visibility defines hidden supervision; input SAM does not define labels.
training.distributed_sampling: DistributedSampler padding recorded; rank-zero BatchNorm buffers broadcast before native validation and checkpointing

inference_geometry.input: RGB restricted to SAM support, SAM mask and its complement
inference_geometry.native_probability: Resize logits to native crop before sigmoid; zero outside crop; no hard support restoration

evaluation.validation: The existing 1264 objects / 217 images and recovered single-mask SAM diagnostic inputs
evaluation.hidden_truth: True amodal mask minus annotated visible mask, fixed across conditions
evaluation.status: Exploratory validation-driven development; no untouched confirmation claim
evaluation.success: The active all-four full-benchmark >=3% goal remains unchanged and unachieved; validation gains alone cannot satisfy it
